description: Search the detection rules ThreatNexus harvests (Splunk ESCU, Elastic, Sigma, Hayabusa, ThreatNexus hunting queries) by keyword, ATT&CK technique or source. Production rules first. Returns metadata, licence and permalink — not the rule bodies. Give at least one of query, technique or source.

query.description: Keyword matched against rule names and descriptions, e.g. "lsass", "scheduled task".

technique.description: ATT&CK technique; a base id also matches its sub-techniques.

name: search_detections
title: Search harvested detection rules
